messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=inference-router in us-west-2. 5m 5xx rate = 18% (baseline 0.3%). Trigger=error-rate-threshold at 2025-11-03T03:12:09Z
pagerduty: Incident INC123456 created and assigned to escalation policy 'oncall-night'. Notifying emma-oncall.
emma-oncall: acked. I'm on it, starting quick triage. tagging @bob-sre @dave-runtime
bob-sre: looking. graphs show a sharp spike around 03:10. 502s mostly from proxy->kvcache path. sample log: "2025-11-03T03:10:58Z proxy=router-3 upstream=kvcache-us-west-2 error=ECONNRESET"
dave-runtime: kv-cache eviction rate jumped x12 in last 5m, memory pressure on kv nodes. might be a warmup / GC storm.
carol-support: support dashboard shows ~12 customer errors since 03:09, a few timeouts for chat completions. flagging customers with PMs.
emma-oncall: quick health check: `curl -sv https://inference.us-west-2.redwood/api/v1/predict -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` returned 502 intermittently from 03:11-03:13.
bob-sre: applying quick mitigation: route small fraction to fallback model (small-l2) and bypass kv-proxy for canary. patching routing weight now.
dave-runtime: command run: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-router FALLBACK_WEIGHT=0.12` and `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/kv-proxy` to force reconnection backoffs. warming caches.
emma-oncall: noted. I'll watch error rate and customer impact. Handoff planned in 30m if not resolved.
bob-sre: also reduced cache TTLs to lower eviction pressure: `redis-cli -h kvcache-usw2 CONFIG SET maxmemory-policy volatile-lru` (applied).
dave-runtime: monitoring: kv miss rate falling and connections stable. backpressure shed from proxy.
incident-bot: Metric update: 5m 5xx rate down to 4.5% at 03:18 (was 18%). Latency stable.
carol-support: sent update to affected customers: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors in us-west-2 and routing mitigations are in progress."
emma-oncall: error rate now 1.8% at 03:26. continuing to monitor for 15m. If stable, we'll close. Great work team. :thumbsup:
mike-product: can we capture a short post-incident note: kvcache eviction surge caused transient 502s; need runbook step to auto-scale kv nodes or reduce TTLs under pressure.
emma-oncall: adding to the incident notes and creating follow-up ticket for runbook updates. will hand off any remaining monitoring to night SRE in 30m if still active.
incident-bot: Alert update: No new pages in last 10m. Auto-close scheduled in 15m if metrics remain stable.
